title: This tour was a highlight...
text: This tour was a highlight of our trip to Barcelona. I recommend that everyone do this tour.  Ella is extremely knowledgeable and friendly and we are so grateful.
author: Gerald_F

title: A Tour Not To Miss!
text: Our guide was extremely knowledgible about history of the area, especially as it related to Jewish history, but he also showed us some fascinaring architectural structures going back to Rome times.. However, what was most fascinating, were the wonderful stories he told about the convrseos. I highly recommend this tour!!
author: Farryl_D

title: Ella delightful and...
text: Ella delightful and friendly. She was extremely knowledgeable, very easy to understand and related things to present and past history. She was able to answer any questions that we had and I would recommend her to anybody.
author: Reva_T

title: Jewish Heritage Tour in Barcelona
text: The information was very interesting and the depth was mostly up to us. Our guide was Ella and she was outstanding in every way
author: Bernard_B

title: A learning experience
text: The Guide was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. We learned so much about the city and the Jewish Quarter.
author: Richard_B

title: Barcelona Jewish History Tour
text: Our guide, Dina, was prompt and informative. She was interesting and shared visual illustrations with us. We would recommend this tour to others.
author: 387barryd

title: Outstanding Jewish Quarter Tour
text: Our guide, Lilach, was outstanding! Lilach walked us through the jewish quarter giving us a detailed historical explanation that was very relatable. She answered all of our questions and paced the tour to see and talk about things important to us. Again it was great experience and I definitely would recommend it to others.
author: Sindee_W

title: Great tour
text: Dina was excellent.  Gave us historical perspective combining maps and pictures.   Excellent way to understand Jewish history in Barcelona.
author: Eric_K

title: Great to experience with tour guide.
text: Lilach is an amazing tour guide. She navigated the history of Spain, Barcelona and the Jews perfectly. I learned an incredible amount about the Jewish experience up to and past 1492. She was able to answer all our questions and explain clearly and in great detail. I highly recommend the tour experience and our tour guide.
author: Victor_R
